_comment: TEMPLATE with an empty token array. Project-name token list, read by tools/sync-plugin.ps1. Before the sync writes any file into the plugin repository, it searches that file's text for each token below. Any hit stops the sync with exit code 5 and a report naming the file, the token and the line. The check runs on the outbound direction only: a token found in a file arriving FROM the plugin means the plugin is already contaminated, and refusing the pull would leave the consuming repository stuck with the contaminated copy it already has.
_extension_seam: Add a string to 'tokens'. Never add a file to an exemption list, because there is none: an 'allowed' entry is an exact string, never a file name. Exempting a whole file would exempt every reference added to it later.
_what_belongs_in_tokens: The repository name, the front-end application names, the database names, the source-project prefix, any vendor or broker names the domain uses, and the project's own handbook file names.
